lines.text: Many learners say: I am not understand the lesson.
Better: I do not understand the lesson.
Does not! She does not understand me.

data.wrong: I am not understand the lesson.
data.right: I do not understand the lesson.

native.hook: النفي: do not لا am not
native.tip: النفي مع الأفعال في الإنجليزية يكون بـ do not لا بـ am not: “I do not understand the lesson.” وليس “I am not understand the lesson.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I am not understand the lesson” 😅 النفي مع الأفعال يكون بـ do not، فالجملة الصحيحة “I do not understand the lesson.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “does not” — النفي مع الأفعال يكون بـ do not. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Negation: do not, not am not
en.tip: With verbs we use do not: “I do not understand the lesson.” not “I am not understand the lesson.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I am not understand the lesson” 😅 In English we use do not with verbs, so the right sentence is “I do not understand the lesson.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
